title: Agent Plugins conformance load report
description: What an adapter prints to stdout after loading one plugin directory. See ADAPTERS.md.

rejected.description: null when the plugin loaded. Otherwise a short reason. The runner compares null against non-null; the reason string itself is informational and is only echoed in failure output.

skills.description: Skill names, as the client would expose them. Order is not significant.

mcpServers.description: MCP server names, the member names from mcp.json. Order is not significant.

skipped.description: Components dropped at a failure boundary. Reporting these is a SHOULD in the specification, so a mismatch here is a warning rather than a failure unless --strict-reporting is passed.

what.description: skills/<dir> for a skill, mcp.json#<name> for one server entry, skills or mcp.json for a whole component type.

ruleId.description: Optional. The kit's rule id if the client can map to one. A different id is noted, never failed.

reported.description: Fields the specification requires the client to report and ignore. Both cases (§5.2 unknown top-level field, §8.1 non-object extensions) are MUST report, so a mismatch here is a failure.

field.description: The manifest field name, for example "skills" or "extensions".
